recipes.title: Lemon Chicken & Mushroom Protein Pasta

items.i: chicken thigh fillets, blitzed into mince
Parmesan, freshly grated, plus extra to serve

steps: Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high until just smoking. Spread the chicken mince out, season, and leave it 3–4 minutes to brown, then break it up and cook about 5 minutes total. Remove.
In the same pan, add the mushrooms with a pinch of salt and don't touch them for 3–4 minutes so they brown.
Add the onion and cook 3–4 minutes until soft, then the garlic for 1 minute.
Return the chicken and juices, add the stock pots and stock, bring to a simmer and reduce by half, 5–6 minutes, until glossy.
Meanwhile boil the spaghetti in salted water for 2 minutes less than the packet says. Save a cup of pasta water and drain.
Toss the pasta in the sauce, then take it off the heat. Stir in the Parmesan, lemon zest and juice and two-thirds of the chives, then loosen with pasta water to the consistency you like.
Divide into 5 containers and finish with extra Parmesan, pepper and the rest of the chives.
recipes.notes: Ingredients come from the video description and per-serve macros from the on-screen card; the full method is on Chef Jack's site (linked). No cream — the sauce is a Parmesan and pasta-water emulsion. Chicken thigh mince keeps it juicy.
